summary: Bounded the Agent event buffer filled by run_active_turn_cancelable: new pub const MAX_BUFFERED_AGENT_EVENTS = 4096; after each run the buffer is compacted in one O(n) retain pass that drops the oldest delta-type events (Provider TextDelta/ReasoningDelta/ToolCallDelta and ToolProgress) first and never drops terminal/status events. Added Agent::buffered_event_count(). Fixed the stale max_tool_iterations field comment (said default 8; actual default 1000, clamp 1..=10000).
diff_stat: 6 files changed, 309 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-) (shared ZE-107/ZE-212 commit, code + tests)

validation_result.validator: pass: undrained_event_buffer_stays_bounded_across_one_hundred_turns - 100 turns x 201 provider events without take_events keep buffered_event_count() <= 4096 after every turn; all 100 TurnAccepted and 100 TextDone survive

notes: Terminal events are never dropped, so the cap can only be exceeded if a host never drains and the buffer holds zero deltas (terminal events are a few per turn). The per-run local Vec in run_active_turn_cancelable is still unbounded within a single turn by design (bounded once appended). No new unwrap/unsafe/Arc<Mutex> in src.
